G8911.def:
1. to strike or dash against , τί τινι (Iliad by Homer); ἀψῖδα πέτρῳ πρ. letting it dash against , (Euripides); τὸν πρὶν ὄλβον ἕρματι πρ. to wreck his happiness on a rock, (Aeschulus Tragicus); πρ. θηρία τινί to set them on him, (Demosthenes Orator); πρ. δόρυ τινί (Euripides):—;without any notion of violence, to put to, apply , μαλακὰν χέρα πρ. Λακεδαιμονίοις Ὀλυμπιάδα to give them the honour of an Olympic victory, (Herdotus Historicus); πρ. κακὸν τῇ πόλει (Aeschulus Tragicus); εὔκλειαν σαυτῇ (Sophocles Tragicus); πρ. δεῖμά τινι, Lat. incutere timorem alicui, (Euripides)
3. with accusative of the object struck, ἀρούρας προσβάλλειν, of the Sun, to strike the earth with his rays, (Homer); of smells, βροτοῦ [ ὀσμὴ] με προσέβαλε (Aristophanes Comicus)

G8916.def: to look at, behold , (Mimnermus Lyricus), etc.; compare aorist2 προσεῖδον:—;so in Mid., προσορωμένα (Sophocles Tragicus) (ML)

G8917.def:
1. to speak to one, to address, accost , (Homer), etc.; πρ. ὀνόματί τινα (Demosthenes Orator):—;with double accusative, τί προσείπω ς᾽ ἔπο; (Aristophanes Comicus)

G8922.def:
1. soft, gentle, kindly , (Pindar); προσηνές τι λέγειν (Thucydides)

G8924.def:

G8926.def: to set on fire or burn besides :—;Pass., σκεύη προσκεκαυμένα pots burnt at the fire , (Aristophanes Comicus): metaphorically, προσκαίεσθαί τινι to be in love with . . , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G8927.def:

G8929.def:
1. to be placed or laid by or upon, to lie by or upon , οὔατα προσέκειτο handles were upon it, (Iliad by Homer); τῇ θύρᾳ προσκεῖσθαι to keep close to the door, (Aristophanes Comicus); δοκοὶ τῷ τείχει προσκείμεναι lying near the wall, (Thucydides):—; ὁ προσκείμενος ἵππος the inside horse (turning a corner), (Sophocles Tragicus)
2. to lie beside, cling to , (Sophocles Tragicus): of a woman, to be given to wife , τινί (Herdotus Historicus)
3. generally, to be involved in or bound up with good or evil, with dative, (Sophocles Tragicus)
4. to be attached or devoted to , τινί (Herdotus Historicus), etc.; πρ. τῷ λεγομένῳ to put faith in a story, (Herdotus Historicus); πρ. οἴνῳ to be addicted to wine, (Herdotus Historicus); ἄγραις hunting, (Sophocles Tragicus), etc.

7. with a thing for the subject, to fall to, belong to , τοῖσι θεῶν τιμὴ αὕτη προσκέαται (Herdotus Historicus); πρ. τινι δοῦλος (Euripides):—; to be laid upon as a charge, to do something, with infinitive, (Herdotus Historicus)
